technical-summary: Added IN_PROGRESS transport observation kind for live turn-state visibility; rewrote gpt-auto _poll_response to treat timeout as safety valve (not terminal); added config key aliasing for hyphenated YAML keys; improved is_generating DOM checks for browsing states; wired IN_PROGRESS through ACP, Pi RPC tap, and status observer.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto turns now emit in-progress signals during long waits, and timeout no longer kills a live turn — it only errors on genuine hangs.

technical-summary: gpt-auto gateway integration and transport reliability: (1) added gpt-auto execution profile + agent definition for MCP dispatch; (2) IN_PROGRESS observation kind with model_activity attribute, wired through ACP, Pi RPC tap, status observer and turn event projector; (3) timeout as safety valve — transport keeps polling until stability passes or cancellation, only errors on genuine hangs; (4) config key aliasing for hyphenated YAML keys; (5) is_generating() now checks stop button tooltip ('stop answering') — stays True through streaming/thinking/browsing, only goes False when done; (6) response-timeout bumped to 600s.
user-summary-candidate: gpt-auto usable through agent MCP with reliable turn completion — no premature returns during browsing or thinking phases.

technical-summary: agent_task_wait now polls with short intervals (120s cap per poll) instead of a single blocking call, so it never outlives the MCP transport timeout. On timeout, returns current status with wait-timeout=True and progress info instead of throwing an MCP error.
user-summary-candidate: agent_task_wait now returns request status + progress on timeout instead of crashing with MCP error
